name: Ylopo
tagline: AI lead generation and nurture for real estate agents.
description: Ylopo is a digital marketing and lead-generation platform built for real estate agents and teams. It runs AI-powered Facebook, Instagram, and Google remarketing to capture buyer and seller leads, then nurtures them with its 'raiya' AI assistant over SMS and voice — qualifying prospects and booking appointments around the clock. It plugs into IDX home-search sites and popular CRMs to keep leads engaged across a long buying cycle.
insight: Beyond the monthly fee, Ylopo requires its own ad spend plus a one-time setup fee of around $1,500.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary 'raiya' AI assistant for text (raiya Text) and voice (raiya Voice) follow-up.

edge: Pairs paid social and Google remarketing with a 'raiya' AI assistant that nurtures leads over both text and voice — generation and follow-up in one stack.
pros: Strong paid-social and Google lead generation
Integrates with major real estate CRMs
cons: No public pricing; requires a demo
Setup fee plus required ad spend on top
